hero.name: Mycelium API Gateway
hero.tagline: Secure, extensible API gateway for modern applications
hero.description: Connect. Secure. Scale. A resilient, organic API gateway that connects hundreds of services with the speed and reliability of a neural network.

security.title: Security-first
security.description: JWT-based authentication, magic-link login, and fine-grained role permissions out of the box.

performance.title: High performance
performance.description: Built with Rust and Actix-Web — zero-cost abstractions and async I/O for maximum throughput.

extensibility.title: Extensible
extensibility.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 API, webhooks, and a Python SDK to integrate with your downstream services.

guestManager.title: Guest Manager

subscriptionsManager.title: Subscriptions Manager

systemManager.title: System Manager

systemManager.abountContent: The system manager must deal with problems and resources throughout the system.

tenantOwner.title: Tenant Owner

tenantManager.title: Tenant Manager

Federation.title: Federation
Federation.loadError: Could not load the data. Try again later.

Peers.title: Federation peers
Peers.quarantineDescription: Quarantine {{name}}? Its requests are refused and the assertions stored from it are dropped until it is released.
Peers.releaseDescription: Release {{name}} from quarantine? It is handshaken again before it is trusted.

switch.title: Federation switch
switch.description: Turns federation on or off for this instance. Off is the kill-switch: the instance stops answering peers and refuses every peer request. The gateway does not report the current state, so only the result of a switch made here is shown.
switch.turnOnDescription: Turn federation on? The gateway refuses this while federation is not configured.
switch.turnOffDescription: Turn federation off? Every peer request is refused until it is turned on again.

Links.title: Identity links
Links.revokeDescription: Revoke the identity link of {{email}}? Grants asserted through it stop applying.

Translations.title: Translation rules
Translations.description: A rule turns a peer grant (issuer tenant, role and minimum permission) into a local guest grant on a local account.
Translations.enableDescription: Enable the rule for issuer role {{role}}? It applies on the next request.
Translations.disableDescription: Disable the rule for issuer role {{role}}? It stops applying on the next request.
Translations.deleteDescription: Delete the rule for issuer role {{role}}? This cannot be undone.

CreateRule.title: Create translation rule
CreateRule.description: Pick a peer, then the issuer grant to match and the local grant it becomes.
CreateRule.issuerRoleHint: The slug of the role on the peer
CreateRule.rolesUnknown: The peer does not share its role vocabulary now. Type the role slug.
CreateRule.rolesRejected: The peer's role vocabulary failed verification ({{reason}}). Type the role slug.
CreateRule.rolesError: Could not read the peer's roles ({{reason}}). Type the role slug.
CreateRule.localAccountHint: A local tenant account; system accounts are refused

unavailable.title: Federation is not available on this gateway
unavailable.description: This instance was built without federation, so it cannot join a peer mesh. Federation is not supported in standalone mode; it needs a full or postgres-only build with the federation feature.
